name: Run failure outcome → dispatched→failed (D3 zombie-guard replacement)
description:
beta.160 flag-day — the product-owned replacement for the upstream D3 zombie guard. Through beta.159 the framework MilestoneSubscriber failed a dispatched root run whose loop terminated without a confirmed handoff; beta.160 made the subscriber observe-only (no TriplePublisher, no lifecycle write capability), so a failure that lands while the run is still `dispatched` — a spawn-publish failure, or a dispatch coordinator that dies before stamping rule.task.spawned — would wedge the run in `dispatched` forever with no rule matching (rule 04's phase guard requires `executing`).

This rule closes that hole with the same marker economy as rule 04: it consumes the durable agent.run.outcome=failed stamp (written by agent-run/05+06 on any involuntary coordinator terminal — those rules key on the run ANCHOR, not on phase or handoff, so the stamp lands for pre-handoff deaths too) and advances dispatched→failed via lifecycle_transition. dispatched→failed is a legal edge in the AgentRun phase machine at beta.160 (agentrun.go:47).

Disjointness with rule 04 is BY PHASE GUARD, exactly as the old D3/rule-04 split was: whichever phase the run is in when the failed marker's KV revision evaluates, exactly one of the two rules matches. The rule-02 race (handoff marker and failed marker both landing while dispatched) is the same narrow window the upstream guard had: the first transition wins and the loser's phase guard goes false on the re-evaluation; a lost lifecycle_transition against a terminal phase is rejected by the machine as an invalid edge (audit-visible, not corrupting).

on_enter.reason: the dispatch coordinator failed before a confirmed handoff — dispatched root run failed (beta.160 product-owned D3 zombie-guard replacement)

metadata.twin_of: 04-executing-to-failed.json — identical shape, phase guard dispatched instead of executing. Together the pair covers every involuntary-failure phase; the pre-160 split was rule 04 + the framework D3 guard.
metadata.stamped_by: agent-run/05+06 add_triple agent.run.outcome=failed on the run anchor — they fire on ANY involuntary coordinator terminal (failed/truncated) with a run anchor, handoff or not, so the marker reaches dispatched-phase runs.
metadata.supersedes: Upstream MilestoneSubscriber D3 zombie guard (agentrun.go dispatched-root fallback, deleted at beta.160 — the subscriber is observe-only).
